heavy_rain.name: heavy_rain_mm

parameters.scope: rainfall depth only; not erosion or soil loss

heavy_rain.note: Applied to NASA POWER daily values, which are Local Solar Time days (time_standard=LST), not a rolling 24-hour window; a storm split across two solar days can fall below the value on each day. Rainfall-depth weather metric only: not erosion, runoff or soil loss. Zero-count winters are valid results.

source.title: North Carolina Climate Science Report: Plain Language Summary; March 2020

thresholds.baseline: 1981-01-01..2025-06-30 daily record of this location's snapshot

note: One point per valid termination date (reference-year calendar). A date that crosses Feb 29 has a different real gap in leap years (`gap_days_in_leap_years`); each historical season is evaluated with its own real gap. With the fixed 14-day rule the check count is a step: the dry-year count below 14 days, 0 at or above (unless the grower reports a low-moisture concern, which fires every evaluable season below 14 days). Each point's `qualifying_years` are the seasons the check would have fired for that end date (same meaning as the comparison check; its length equals `checks_count`, and it is empty when the count is 0).
